name: SRE
purpose: Provoz serverů svr03 a 186: kapacita, nasazení, CI runnery, zálohy, observability stack a sentinel; denní kontrola kapacity a týdenní revize spolehlivosti.

schedules.name: SRE: denní kontrola kapacity
schedules.title: SRE: denní kontrola kapacity
schedules.notes:
Purpose: see capacity trouble (disk, memory, swap, restarts) a day before it is an incident. Source: the SRE's daily routine.

Follow 'Daily capacity check' in your instructions. All within thresholds: complete with one line, no message.
schedules.definition_of_done: Both hosts checked; anything over a threshold is a task with an owner; all green is one line.

schedules.name: SRE: týdenní revize spolehlivosti
schedules.title: SRE: týdenní revize spolehlivosti
schedules.notes:
Purpose: catch slow problems before they are incidents: capacity trends, backups, certificates, CI runners, sentinel noise. Source: the SRE's weekly routine.

Follow 'Weekly reliability review' in your instructions.
schedules.definition_of_done: A short Czech note (topic provoz) with the numbers and at most 3 actions, each a task with an owner.

note: Owns the sentinel (ops/sentinel) and the observability stack; the Hlídač (its report) triages the incidents and posts the code-built daily health digest.
